label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app
title: EVM Resolve
reasons: The page presents itself as an 'Advanced AI decentralized protocol for wallets' that performs 'test transactions' and other wallet functions, funneling users to a wallet connection page via the 'CONNECT' button that redirects to '/connect/index.html'.

The page contains a hidden Coinbase Wallet SDK link with a specific secret and server parameter (walletlink.org) for wallet connection, which is a mechanism used to sign malicious transactions that drain funds.
The page disables right-click and keyboard shortcuts (F12, Ctrl+Shift+I, etc.) to prevent inspection, a common tactic of malicious wallet drainer sites.
